title: tier-2 shipped code: the pathing chunk's header fixup against MapChunkHeaderFixup (0x142e49360)
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-tank/src/chunkkind.rs (fixup_header_in_place), built by cargo and called by crates/ow-tank/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the map_chunk_header_fixup entry. The ledger binds the verdict to chunkkind.rs + the probe source + the git revision.

Oracle is MapChunkHeaderFixup at exe 0x142e49360 (v2b 0x7ff7c7b69360), 0x3D bytes. The client converts three self-relative RVAs of the record - at +0x00, +0x08 and +0x18 - to pointers by adding the record's own address, and a stored zero stays zero: each conversion is a `lea` of the value plus the base, a `test` of the value and a `cmove` back to zero when the value was zero. The record's +0x10 is not touched.

The client takes the base from the record's own pointer (RCX) and has no second argument, so the fixture passes the record's arena base in the client's dead second slot: the oracle and the probe write the same absolute values and the whole 0x20-byte record is compared without masking.

The fixture varies the three slots between zero, ordinary offsets and a value that wraps when the base is added, and puts a marker in +0x10 so a spurious write there is caught. The all-zero case is the null boundary the file actually carries.

The function has no allocator and no external call. Its one decision is branchless - each of the three conversions is a `cmove` - so the coverage stage finds no conditional branch site in the body and reports 0 of 0. The mutation stage carries the proof instead: the three `== 0` comparisons are the only behaviour the function has, and all three are mutated and killed.
acknowledgedGaps: Offset arithmetic only: the unit proves the rebase formula and the exact slot set. It says nothing about what the pointers point at; the STUD loader and the cell fixup are fn/MapChunkCellBytesFixup's subject.
The client has no bounds check. The 0x20-byte record is always long enough for the three slots it reads; a shorter record would fault on the client.
The client's branchless `cmove` gives the coverage stage nothing to measure, so the unit's coverage figure is 0 of 0 sites and the mutation stage is the only evidence that the zero rule is observed.
The sibling relocators of the same dispatch - 0x142e49270 (two pointers), 0x142e493a0 (+0x2E8/+0x2F0) and 0x142e493e0 (+0x08) - are not implemented and not verified here.
